topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: Per its-magic phase/role, use cheaper models for light work (ask, refresh-context) and strong models for coding/architecture (execute, dev, tech-lead), automatically when /auto spawns subagents — without hardcoding volatile model IDs like composer-2.5 or claude-opus-4-8 in framework template files.

.cursor/agents/*.mdc (active + template/), .cursor/scratchpad.md + scratchpad.local.example.md, optional .cursor/model-catalog.local.json (gitignored) + example, docs/engineering/runbook.md, docs/engineering/auto-orchestration-reference.md, scripts/model_tier_lib.py (or equivalent resolver), tests/auto_command_contract_test.py, check_intake_template_parity scope, architecture decision + # US-0101.

MODEL_TIER is orthogonal to TOKEN_PROFILE (DEC-0062 — context breadth only, never model choice). Template ships stable Cursor aliases fast and inherit only; concrete slugs live in operator-local catalog. Document MODEL_PROVIDER_MODE cursor vs api-only BYOK: subagents may not inherit custom API keys (known Cursor limitation). No weakening US-0048/US-0069 spawn-only isolation or mandatory QA/release gates.

Contract tests for scratchpad tier keys, default phase-to-tier matrix literals, orthogonality paragraph vs TOKEN_PROFILE, template agent model: fast/inherit markers, local catalog schema validation, MODEL_RESOLVE_FALLBACK reason codes, and check_intake_template_parity --scope=model-tier when surfaces touched.

Single story US-0101: operators can configure per-phase model tiers via scratchpad + optional local slug catalog; template agents use stable aliases; runbook documents API-only caveats; release flips DONE per US-0045.
